tool.name: z2h_search_marketplace
tool.title: Search Zero to Hundred marketplace
tool.description: Find live software by keyword before building from scratch. Public, no sign-in needed. Returns descriptions, USD license prices, tech stacks and listing links. Example: {"search": "invoice", "limit": 5}. Empty search browses recent software. When hasMore is true without nextCursor, narrow the search. Matching is lexical. Errors set isError; retry a rate limit later. Use z2h_compare_marketplace_listings for a shortlist or z2h_show_marketplace for cards. A result does not guarantee suitability or purchase availability.

tool.name: z2h_create_draft_listing
tool.title: Create a Zero to Hundred draft listing
tool.description: Create an invisible draft and return editUrl and publishUrl. Price and source inclusion are Builder decisions. Set sourceCodeIncluded only after confirmation; omitted values default to false. Requires listings:write. Returns the draft identity and web edit/review links. Check z2h_list_my_listings before retrying, because creation is not idempotent. Source delivery, review and publishing continue in the web wizard.

tool.name: z2h_request_source_upload
tool.title: Request a draft source archive upload
tool.description: For an owned draft, get a short-lived signed archive URL. Ask the Builder to explicitly accept this exact statement: "I own or have the rights to sell the codebase I am about to upload." Pass ownershipAccepted=true and ownershipVersion=2026-09-27 only after they accept. PUT up to 100 MB to signedUrl, then call z2h_confirm_source_upload. This does not publish.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Zero to Hundred marketplace to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Zero to Hundred marketplace to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://zerotohundred.ai/api/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Zero to Hundred marketplace MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 16, 2026, Zero to Hundred marketplace scores 96/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: How clear is Zero to Hundred marketplace's MCP tool documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 16, 2026, Zero to Hundred marketplace scores 91/100 in Manufact's review of tool titles, descriptions, input and output schemas, and behavior annotations. The review covers 9 of 9 discovered tools. The quality score measures documentation clarity; runtime behavior and marketplace readiness require separate checks.
